Q5738.reason: Mixed goods/services contracts fall under the UCC unless the predominant purpose is the services, so Connie prevails under the UCC unless the service agreement predominates.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and the defendant entered the open party only to have a good time, forming the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: The agitated, drug-seeking presentation fits addiction or withdrawal, where chronic use downregulates post-synaptic dopamine receptors.
